fraction_of_historical_result_explainabl.definition: maximum fixed synthetic alpha shift divided by absolute observed direct alpha; values above one mean a sign reversal is mathematically possible under an explicit bound, not that it occurred

loss_intensity_that_eliminates_alpha.reason: Observed direct incremental alpha is already non-positive before any synthetic missing-asset loss.

interpretation: The frozen selector has negative observed incremental alpha versus the contemporaneous unfiltered PIT basket. Some selector-favourable synthetic loss assignments can change the sign, proving dependence on unobserved assumptions rather than robust alpha. Neutral/adversarial bounds do not support promotion.
